// Regeneration instructions for the protocol-3 golden fixtures.
//
// This file is stored with a .txt extension so that cargo does not compile it
// as a test of the current crate. To regenerate the fixtures from the release
// that defined protocol 3:
//   1. Check out the release tag in a separate worktree
//      (git worktree add --detach <dir> v0.33.0).
//   2. Copy this file to <dir>/crates/protocol/tests/golden_v3.rs.
//   3. From <dir>, with every POHUNEK_* variable unset, run
//        GOLDEN_V3_OUT=<repo>/crates/protocol/tests/fixtures/compat/v3 \
//          cargo test -p pohunek-protocol --test golden_v3 -- --nocapture
//      GOLDEN_V3_OUT names the directory that receives requests.json,
//      results.json and events.json; the test fails when it is unset.
// The test asserts that every method in METHOD_SPECS and every event in
// EVENT_SPECS of the checked-out release has at least one entry, and that each
// JSON literal equals its own typed re-serialization. Object keys are written in
// sorted order because serde_json maps are sorted without preserve_order.

//! Generator for the protocol-3 golden fixtures.
//!
//! Every value starts as a JSON literal that is parsed through this release's
//! strict typed structs and serialized back, so the recorded JSON is exactly
//! what this release emits. A literal that differs from its own re-serialized
//! form fails the run, which keeps the literals canonical and free of typos.

use std::{collections::BTreeSet, fs, path::PathBuf};

use protocol::{
    method::{self, Method},
    ApprovalKeyReference, EnrollmentInfo, EnrollmentRevision, EnrollmentStatus,
    HostGovernanceStatus, HostId, HostOwner, OwnerRevision, PrincipalId, QuarantineReason, RelayId,
    PROTOCOL_VERSION,
};
use serde::{de::DeserializeOwned, Serialize};
use serde_json::{json, Value};

const RELEASE: &str = "v0.33.0";
const COMMIT: &str = "e6fcf2377ba14a51d8e7de971c13e1e86a864134";
const OUT_DIR_ENV: &str = "GOLDEN_V3_OUT";

/// Parses `literal` into `T`, serializes it back, and requires the two JSON
/// values to be identical.
fn canonical<T: Serialize + DeserializeOwned>(literal: Value) -> Value {
    let typed: T = serde_json::from_value(literal.clone())
        .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("literal rejected by {}: {error}\n{literal:#}", std::any::type_name::<T>()));
    let value = serde_json::to_value(&typed).expect("serialize typed value");
    assert_eq!(
        value,
        literal,
        "literal is not the canonical serialization of {}",
        std::any::type_name::<T>()
    );
    value
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Recorder {
    requests: Vec<Value>,
    results: Vec<Value>,
    events: Vec<Value>,
}

impl Recorder {
    fn request<M: Method>(&mut self, params: Value) {
        let params = canonical::<M::Params>(params);
        self.requests.push(json!({"method": M::NAME, "params": params}));
    }

    fn result<M, T>(&mut self, result: Value)
    where
        M: Method<Output = T>,
        T: Serialize + DeserializeOwned,
    {
        let result = canonical::<T>(result);
        self.results.push(json!({"method": M::NAME, "result": result}));
    }

    fn event<T: Serialize + DeserializeOwned>(&mut self, name: &str, payload: Value) {
        let payload = canonical::<T>(payload);
        self.events.push(json!({"event": name, "payload": payload}));
    }
}

fn governance_id(prefix: &str) -> String {
    format!("{prefix}{}", "A".repeat(protocol::GOVERNANCE_ID_PAYLOAD_BYTES))
}

fn governance_status(status: EnrollmentStatus, quarantine: Option<QuarantineReason>) -> Value {
    let status = HostGovernanceStatus::new(
        HostId::parse(&governance_id("host_")).expect("host id"),
        Some(EnrollmentInfo::new(
            RelayId::parse(&governance_id("relay_")).expect("relay id"),
            status,
            EnrollmentRevision::new(4).expect("enrollment revision"),
        )),
        Some(HostOwner::Principal(
            PrincipalId::parse(&governance_id("principal_")).expect("principal id"),
        )),
        Some(OwnerRevision::new(8).expect("owner revision")),
        quarantine,
        ApprovalKeyReference::from_ed25519_verifying_key_bytes([7; 32]),
    )
    .expect("consistent governance status");
    serde_json::to_value(&status).expect("serialize governance status")
}

fn protocol_version() -> Value {
    serde_json::to_value(PROTOCOL_VERSION).expect("serialize protocol version")
}

        "id": "s-43",
        "capabilities": {"resume": false, "fork": false},
        "agent": "shell",
        "agent_base": "shell",
        "cwd": "/workspace/other",
        "pid": 5151,
        "runtime": {"state": "terminal", "runtime_generation": "1"},
        "cols": 80,
        "rows": 24,
        "state": "stopped",
        "state_source": "process",
        "created_at": "2026-06-17T09:00:00Z",
        "updated_at": "2026-06-17T09:30:00Z",
        "exit_code": 130
    })
}

fn with_extra(base: Value, extra: Value) -> Value {
    let mut merged = base;
    merged
        .as_object_mut()
        .expect("object base")
        .extend(extra.as_object().expect("object extra").clone());
    merged
}

fn notification_policy() -> Value {
    let kinds = |agent_blocked: bool, turn_completed: bool, system: bool| {
        json!({
            "agent_blocked": agent_blocked,
            "approval_required": true,
            "turn_completed": turn_completed,
            "session_finished": false,
            "error": true,
            "system": system
        })
    };
    json!({
        "attention_dedupe_window_secs": 90,
        "attention_debounce_secs": 7,
        "enabled": kinds(true, false, false),
        "providers": {
            "claude": kinds(true, true, false),
            "codex": kinds(true, false, true)
        },
        "retention": {
            "sweep_interval_secs": 3600,
            "info_ttl_secs": 86_400,
            "warning_ttl_secs": 172_800,
            "resolved_attention_ttl_secs": 604_800,
            "resolved_error_ttl_secs": 1_209_600,
            "archived_ttl_secs": 2_592_000,
            "compaction_min_actions": 100
        }
    })
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_lines)]
fn record_methods(rec: &mut Recorder) {
    use protocol::*;

    // Requests.
    rec.request::<method::DaemonHealth>(Value::Null);
    rec.request::<method::HostGovernanceInspect>(Value::Null);
    rec.request::<method::SessionNew>(json!({
        "agent": "claude",
        "name": "review auth flow",
        "cwd": "/workspace/project",
        "cols": 120,
        "rows": 40,
        "project": "p-7",
        "repo": "/workspace/project",
        "branch": "feature/auth",
        "base_branch": "main",
        "input": "start the review",
        "metadata": {"owner": "cli", "ticket": "DMD-1356"}
    }));
    rec.request::<method::SessionList>(json!({"filters": [
        {"key": "state", "value": "running"},
        {"key": "activity", "value": "blocked"},
        {"key": "agent", "value": "codex"},
        {"key": "id", "value": "s-42"},
        {"key": "project", "value": "p-7"}
    ]}));
    rec.request::<method::SessionRuntimeInventory>(Value::Null);
    rec.request::<method::SessionInspect>(json!("s-42"));
    rec.request::<method::SessionStop>(json!("s-42"));
    rec.request::<method::SessionResume>(json!("s-42"));
    rec.request::<method::SessionFork>(json!({
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "name": "forked review",
        "cwd_mode": "same",
        "cols": 100,
        "rows": 30
    }));
    rec.request::<method::SessionRemove>(json!("s-42"));
    rec.request::<method::SessionRemoveAcceptingUnconfirmed>(json!("s-42"));
    rec.request::<method::SessionAttach>(json!({
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "initial_dimensions": {"cols": 120, "rows": 40},
        "origin_session_id": "s-1",
        "origin_daemon_id": "daemon-1",
        "origin_worker_id": "worker-9"
    }));
    rec.request::<method::SessionDetach>(json!({"stream_id": "stream-1"}));
    rec.request::<method::SessionResize>(json!({"session_id": "s-42", "cols": 132, "rows": 43}));
    rec.request::<method::SessionInput>(json!({
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "text": "continue\n",
        "wait": {"until": ["idle", "blocked"], "timeout_ms": 5000}
    }));
    rec.request::<method::SessionScreen>(json!({"session_id": "s-42"}));
    rec.request::<method::SessionDetection>(json!({"session_id": "s-42"}));
    rec.request::<method::SessionOutput>(json!({"session_id": "s-42", "max_bytes": 4096}));
    rec.request::<method::SessionOutput>(json!({
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "runtime": runtime_identity(),
        "after_offset": "24",
        "max_bytes": 1024,
        "wait_ms": 250
    }));
    rec.request::<method::SessionRead>(json!({
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "source": "recent_unwrapped",
        "lines": 20,
        "format": "ansi"
    }));
    rec.request::<method::SessionWait>(json!({
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "runtime": runtime_identity(),
        "after_updated_at": "2026-06-17T10:00:00Z",
        "after_terminal_watermark": "7",
        "after_output_offset": "8",
        "states": ["stopped", "failed"],
        "activities": ["blocked"],
        "timeout_ms": 5000
    }));
    rec.request::<method::Subscribe>(Value::Null);
    rec.request::<method::SessionReportNativeId>(json!({
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "runtime_id": "runtime-42",
        "agent": "claude",
        "pid": 4242,
        "pid_start_identity": "777",
        "sequence": "3",
        "expires_at": "2026-07-27T12:00:10Z",
        "native_session_id": "claude-native-abc",
        "transcript_path": "/home/user/.claude/transcripts/abc.jsonl"
    }));
    rec.request::<method::SessionReportAgent>(json!({
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "source": "hook",
        "agent": "claude",
        "activity": "working",
        "seq": "5",
        "pid": 4300,
        "agent_session_id": "claude-active-abc",
        "agent_session_path": "/home/user/.claude/projects/project/abc.jsonl"
    }));
    rec.request::<method::SessionReleaseAgent>(json!({
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "source": "hook",
        "agent": "claude",
        "seq": "6"
    }));
    rec.request::<method::SessionSetMetadata>(json!({
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "metadata": {"owner": "gui", "obsolete": null}
    }));
    rec.request::<method::SessionRename>(json!({"session_id": "s-42", "name": "renamed review"}));
    rec.request::<method::SessionDiff>(json!({"session_id": "s-42", "base": "main"}));
    rec.request::<method::SessionPolicyGet>(Value::Null);
    rec.request::<method::SessionPolicySet>(json!({"retention": {
        "enabled": true,
        "sweep_interval_secs": 600,
        "terminal_ttl_secs": 86_400,
        "lost_ttl_secs": 3600,
        "max_removals_per_sweep": 25
    }}));
    rec.request::<method::SessionRetentionSweep>(json!({"dry_run": true, "limit": 10}));
    rec.request::<method::IntegrationInstall>(json!({"agent": "claude"}));
    rec.request::<method::IntegrationStatus>(json!({"agent": "codex"}));
    rec.request::<method::IntegrationUninstall>(json!({"agent": "codex"}));
    rec.request::<method::IntegrationDoctor>(json!({"agent": "claude"}));
    rec.request::<method::HostInspect>(Value::Null);
    rec.request::<method::AssistantMaterialize>(json!({"snapshot": "{\"sessions\":[],\"projects\":[]}"}));
    rec.request::<method::DaemonDoctor>(Value::Null);
    rec.request::<method::HostDiscover>(json!({"force": true}));
    rec.request::<method::NotificationCreate>(json!({
        "source": {
            "provider": "codex",
            "provider_event": "PermissionRequest",
            "host_local_source_id": "hook-42"
        },
        "kind": "approval_required",
        "severity": "action_required",
        "title": "Approval required",
        "body": "Codex is waiting for a tool approval.",
        "metadata": {"tool": "bash"},
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "agent_kind": "codex",
        "source_id": "src-1",
        "dedupe_key": "approval:s-42",
        "project_id": "p-7"
    }));
    rec.request::<method::NotificationList>(json!({
        "status": "unread",
        "kind": "approval_required",
        "severity": "action_required",
        "provider": "codex",
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "created_after": "2026-07-03T08:00:00Z",
        "created_before": "2026-07-03T10:00:00Z",
        "limit": 50,
        "cursor": "page-2"
    }));
    rec.request::<method::NotificationUpdate>(json!({"id": "n-42", "status": "read"}));
    rec.request::<method::NotificationDelete>(json!({"id": "n-42"}));
    rec.request::<method::NotificationPolicyGet>(Value::Null);
    rec.request::<method::NotificationPolicySet>(json!({"policy": notification_policy()}));
    rec.request::<method::NotificationRetentionPrune>(json!({
        "dry_run": true,
        "status": "archived",
        "before": "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z",
        "limit": 100
    }));
    rec.request::<method::ProjectList>(json!({"filters": [
        {"key": "source", "value": "manual"},
        {"key": "label", "value": "project"},
        {"key": "id", "value": "p-7"}
    ]}));
    rec.request::<method::ProjectAdd>(json!({
        "path": "/workspace/project",
        "name": "project",
        "base_branch": "main"
    }));
    rec.request::<method::ProjectShow>(json!({"reference": "project"}));
    rec.request::<method::ProjectRename>(json!({"reference": "project", "name": "renamed"}));
    rec.request::<method::ProjectRemove>(json!({"reference": "project", "prune_worktrees": true}));
    rec.request::<method::ProjectPrompt>(json!({"reference": "project", "name": "issue"}));
    rec.request::<method::ProjectAction>(json!({"reference": "project", "name": "review-pr"}));
    rec.request::<method::ProjectActions>(json!({"reference": "project"}));
    rec.request::<method::WorktreeRemove>(json!({"path": "/workspace/project/.worktrees/feature-auth"}));

    // Results.
    rec.result::<method::DaemonHealth, DaemonHealthResult>(json!({
        "status": "ok",
        "daemon_version": "0.33.0",
        "protocol_version": protocol_version()
    }));
    rec.result::<method::HostGovernanceInspect, HostGovernanceStatus>(governance_status(
        EnrollmentStatus::Quarantined,
        Some(QuarantineReason::ProjectionConflict),
    ));
    rec.result::<method::SessionNew, SessionNewResult>(with_extra(
        session_full(),
        json!({"applied_input": true}),
    ));
    rec.result::<method::SessionList, Vec<SessionInfo>>(json!([session_full(), session_stopped()]));
    rec.result::<method::SessionRuntimeInventory, RuntimeInventoryResult>(json!({"entries": [
        {
            "runtime_slot": "slot-1",
            "claimed_session_id": "s-42",
            "worker_id": "worker-1",
            "runtime_id": "runtime-42",
            "status": "managed",
            "reason": "authenticated"
        },
        {
            "runtime_slot": "slot-2",
            "claimed_session_id": "s-77",
            "worker_id": "worker-2",
            "runtime_id": "runtime-77",
            "status": "orphaned",
            "reason": "no durable session record"
        },
        {"runtime_slot": "slot-3", "status": "incompatible"}
    ]}));
    rec.result::<method::SessionInspect, SessionInfo>(session_full());
    rec.result::<method::SessionStop, SessionStopResult>(json!({"stopped": true}));
    rec.result::<method::SessionResume, SessionResumeResult>(json!({"session": session_full()}));
    rec.result::<method::SessionFork, SessionForkResult>(with_extra(
        session_full(),
        json!({"applied_input": false}),
    ));
    rec.result::<method::SessionRemove, SessionRemoveResult>(json!({
        "removed": true,
        "stopped": false,
        "worktrees_removed": 1,
        "worktrees_failed": 0
    }));
    rec.result::<method::SessionRemoveAcceptingUnconfirmed, SessionRemoveResult>(json!({
        "removed": true,
        "stopped": true,
        "worktrees_removed": 1,
        "worktrees_failed": 1,
        "accepted_unconfirmed_processes": [
            {"pid": 4242, "start_identity": "9007199254740993", "command": "ssh-agent"},
            {"pid": 7, "start_identity": "1"}
        ]
    }));
    rec.result::<method::SessionAttach, SessionAttachResult>(json!({"stream_id": "stream-1"}));
    rec.result::<method::SessionDetach, SessionDetachResult>(json!({
        "detached": false,
        "error": {
            "class": "runtime",
            "code": "worker_attach_stream_failed",
            "msg": "worker attach stream failed"
        }
    }));
    rec.result::<method::SessionResize, SessionResizeResult>(json!({"session": session_full()}));
    rec.result::<method::SessionInput, SessionInputResult>(json!({
        "accepted": true,
        "activity": "idle",
        "activity_source": "report",
        "runtime": runtime_identity(),
        "activity_epoch": "d-epoch-1",
        "activity_revision": "7"
    }));
    rec.result::<method::SessionScreen, SessionScreenResult>(json!({
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "worker_id": "worker-1",
        "runtime_id": "runtime-42",
        "runtime_generation": "3",
        "watermark": "9007199254740993",
        "dimensions": {"cols": 120, "rows": 40},
        "cursor": {"row": 3, "col": 7, "visible": true},
        "alternate_screen": false,
        "title": "Build",
        "progress": "40%",
        "visible_lines": ["one", "two"]
    }));
    rec.result::<method::SessionDetection, SessionDetectionResult>(json!({
        "session_id": "s-42",
        "supported_regions": [
            "osc_title",
            "osc_progress",
            "whole_recent",
            "bottom_lines",
            "bottom_non_empty_lines",
            "top_non_empty_lines",
            "last_non_empty_above_prompt_box",
            "after_last_prompt_marker",
            "prompt_box_body",
            "after_last_horizontal_rule"
        ],
        "previews": [{
            "kind": "top_non_empty_lines",
            "region": "top_non_empty_lines(8)",
            "text": "Do you trust the contents of this directory?"
        }]
    }));
    rec.result::<method::SessionOutput, SessionOutputResult>(output_result());
    rec.result::<method::SessionRead, SessionReadResult>(json!({

fn record_events(rec: &mut Recorder) {
    use protocol::*;

    rec.event::<AgentStateEvent>(
        event::AGENT_STATE,
        json!({
            "session_id": "s-42",
            "activity": "blocked",
            "source": "osc_title",
            "runtime": runtime_identity(),
            "activity_epoch": "d-epoch-1",
            "revision": "7"
        }),
    );
    rec.event::<SubagentStateEvent>(
        event::SUBAGENT_STATE,
        json!({"session_id": "s-42", "subagent": subagent(), "runtime": runtime_identity()}),
    );
    rec.event::<AttachEvent>(
        event::ATTACH_OPENED,
        json!({"session_id": "s-42", "stream_id": "stream-1"}),
    );
    rec.event::<AttachEvent>(
        event::ATTACH_CLOSED,
        json!({"session_id": "s-42", "stream_id": "stream-1"}),
    );
    rec.event::<NotificationCreatedEvent>(
        event::NOTIFICATION_CREATED,
        json!({"record": notification_record()}),
    );
    rec.event::<NotificationUpdatedEvent>(
        event::NOTIFICATION_UPDATED,
        json!({"record": notification_record()}),
    );
    rec.event::<NotificationDeletedEvent>(
        event::NOTIFICATION_DELETED,
        json!({"notification_id": "n-42"}),
    );
    for name in [
        event::SESSION_CREATED,
        event::SESSION_UPDATED,
        event::SESSION_STOPPED,
        event::SESSION_REMOVED,
        event::SESSION_RUNTIME_RECONNECTED,
        event::SESSION_RUNTIME_LOST,
        event::SESSION_RUNTIME_CONFLICT,
    ] {
        rec.event::<SessionEvent>(name, json!({"session": session_full()}));
    }
    rec.event::<RuntimeInventoryEvent>(
        event::SESSION_RUNTIME_DISCOVERED,
        json!({"entry": {
            "runtime_slot": "slot-2",
            "claimed_session_id": "s-77",
            "worker_id": "worker-2",
            "runtime_id": "runtime-77",
            "status": "conflict",
            "reason": "two workers claim the same slot"
        }}),
    );
    rec.event::<SessionNativeRecoveredEvent>(
        event::SESSION_NATIVE_RECOVERED,
        json!({
            "session": session_full(),
            "previous_runtime_id": "runtime-41",
            "runtime_id": "runtime-42"
        }),
    );
}

fn render(kind_key: &str, entries: &[Value]) -> String {
    let document = json!({
        "release": RELEASE,
        "commit": COMMIT,
        "protocol_version": 3,
        "entries": entries,
    });
    assert_eq!(
        PROTOCOL_VERSION,
        protocol::ProtocolVersion::new(3).expect("protocol version 3"),
        "{kind_key}: generator must run against protocol version 3"
    );
    let mut text = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&document).expect("render fixture");
    text.push('\n');
    text
}

#[test]
fn golden_v3_fixtures_cover_every_method_and_event() {
    let mut rec = Recorder::default();
    record_methods(&mut rec);
    record_events(&mut rec);

    let request_names: BTreeSet<&str> = rec
        .requests
        .iter()
        .map(|entry| entry["method"].as_str().expect("method name"))
        .collect();
    let result_names: BTreeSet<&str> = rec
        .results
        .iter()
        .map(|entry| entry["method"].as_str().expect("method name"))
        .collect();
    let event_names: BTreeSet<&str> = rec
        .events
        .iter()
        .map(|entry| entry["event"].as_str().expect("event name"))
        .collect();
    for spec in method::METHOD_SPECS {
        assert!(request_names.contains(spec.name), "no request entry for {}", spec.name);
        assert!(result_names.contains(spec.name), "no result entry for {}", spec.name);
    }
    for spec in protocol::event::EVENT_SPECS {
        assert!(event_names.contains(spec.name), "no event entry for {}", spec.name);
    }
    assert_eq!(request_names.len(), method::METHOD_SPECS.len());
    assert_eq!(result_names.len(), method::METHOD_SPECS.len());
    assert_eq!(event_names.len(), protocol::event::EVENT_SPECS.len());

    let out_dir = PathBuf::from(
        std::env::var_os(OUT_DIR_ENV).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{OUT_DIR_ENV} must name the output directory")),
    );
    fs::create_dir_all(&out_dir).expect("create output directory");
    for (file, entries) in [
        ("requests.json", &rec.requests),
        ("results.json", &rec.results),
        ("events.json", &rec.events),
    ] {
        fs::write(out_dir.join(file), render(file, entries)).expect("write fixture");
    }
}
